build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems using the biknn_radius_graph function
build_radius_graph_single: build a radius graph for a single atomic system using the build_radius_graph JIT-compiled function
compute_safe_norm: compute the L2 norm of a tensor with epsilon protection against division by zero using safe_norm
compute_soft_rank: compute soft neighbor rankings for a pairwise distance tensor using the soft_rank function
compute_envelope_fn: compute the envelope function in log space that smoothly vanishes at x equals 1 using envelope_fn
